row: Welcome to the YouTube channel "Horse Rescue"! Here, we share heartfelt stories about saving horses in need, restoring their health, and finding them loving homes. Follow us to experience memorable moments, learn about horse care, and get involved in the mission to protect these four-legged friends. Together, we can bring hope and happiness to the horses that need rescuing!
